name: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China

evidence.summary: CASI’s directory of China’s defence key laboratories lists UESTC as host of the national defence key laboratory of communications anti-jamming technology (since 2023 the National Key Laboratory of Wireless Communications), as co-host with CETC’s 12th Research Institute of the high-power microwave electronic vacuum devices laboratory, whose work serves military radar, electronic warfare and directed-energy weapons, and as co-host with CAEP of the strong radiation laboratory.
items: Defense S&T Key Laboratory of Communications Anti-Jamming Technology (通信抗干扰技术国防科技重点实验室)
Defense S&T Key Laboratory of High-Power Microwave Electronic Vacuum Component Technology (大功率微波电真空器件技术国防科技重点实验室)
Defense S&T Key Laboratory of Strong Radiation (强辐射国防科技重点实验室)

evidence.summary: CASI describes the strong radiation laboratory as a joint venture between CAEP, China’s nuclear-weapons complex, and UESTC, whose branch was set up in 1996; the US Commerce Department had listed UESTC as an alias of CAEP on the Entity List until 2012, when it gave the university an entry of its own.
